description: This file contains JavaScript functions and classes for handling lookup dialogs, popups, AJAX requests, and UI interactions within a web application, specifically related to 'field lookup' functionalities in a web-based UI.

classes.name: Lookup
classes.description: Class managing AJAX-based lookup dialogs, including initialization, container modification, dialog options, and event handling.

classes.name: FieldLookupCounter
classes.description: Counter object for managing multiple lookup instances, providing methods to set, get, create, and remove references.

classes.name: ButtonModifier
classes.description: Class for modifying lookup UI elements, such as collapsing panels, modifying buttons, pagination, and result tables.

classes.name: lookupDescriptionLoaded
classes.description: Helper class for loading and updating lookup field descriptions via AJAX.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the Lookup object, creating container, dialog, and event handlers.

methods.name: _modifyContainer
methods.description: Modifies the input container, changing IDs and adding lookup button and div elements.

methods.name: _createAjaxAutoComplete
methods.description: Sets up AJAX autocomplete if ajaxUrl is provided.

methods.name: _createDialogOptions
methods.description: Creates dialog configuration options based on parameters.

methods.name: _positioning
methods.description: Determines dialog positioning based on options.

methods.name: _dialogOpen
methods.description: Handles opening of lookup dialog, loading data via AJAX.

methods.name: _lookupChaining
methods.description: Sets up lookup chaining if previous lookup is active.

methods.name: _activateLookup
methods.description: Activates a lookup by setting the global ACTIVATED_LOOKUP variable.

methods.name: _addCloseEventForClickingOnBackgroundLayer
methods.description: Adds event to close dialog when clicking outside.

methods.name: _dialogClose
methods.description: Handles closing of dialog and restoring previous lookup state.

methods.name: _addOpenEvent
methods.description: Binds click event to open lookup dialog.

methods.name: lookupAjaxRequest
methods.description: Performs AJAX load for lookup content.

methods.name: lookupFormAjaxRequest
methods.description: Performs AJAX form submission for lookup.

methods.name: lookupPaginationAjaxRequest
methods.description: Performs AJAX pagination for lookup results.

methods.name: setSourceColor
methods.description: Highlights a source element.

methods.name: set_duration_value
methods.description: Sets a value in the calling window for duration fields.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets a value in the calling window.

methods.name: set_values
methods.description: Sets multiple values in the calling window.

methods.name: write_value
methods.description: Writes a value into a target input element.

methods.name: set_multivalues
methods.description: Sets multiple values into target fields, triggers change events.

methods.name: closeLookup
methods.description: Closes the lookup dialog or window.

methods.name: lookupDescriptionLoaded
methods.description: Class for loading and updating lookup descriptions via AJAX.
